title: Co-Sight Harness: Externalized Control Assets and Deterministic Enforcement for Long-Horizon Business Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.17696v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon business workflows fail in two ways: errors accumulate as a chain of activities lengthens, and the knowledge an activity needs is written in a different vocabulary from the user's request. We study whether such workflows can be made reliable without changing the language model. Our method keeps the backbone fixed and moves the workflow definition, state and domain knowledge into versioned control assets outside the model. A state machine and machine-checkable acceptance gates enforce these assets during execution; an independent auditor grades the resulting trace. The assets are updated only after a regression check and human approval .We evaluate the method on three deployed workflows exceeding 200 steps. translated_title: Co-Sight Harness：面向长程业务智能体的外部化控制资产与确定性强制执行机制
translated_abstract: 长程业务工作流会以两种方式失败：随着活动链条的延长，错误不断累积；同时某项活动所需的知识所用词汇与用户请求的表述不一致。我们研究能否在不改变语言模型的前提下使这类工作流变得可靠。我们的方法保持模型骨干固定不变，将工作流定义、状态与领域知识转移到模型外部可版本化管理的控制资产中。在执行过程中，由状态机和机器可校验的验收门控来强制实施这些资产；并由一个独立的审计器对产生的执行轨迹进行评分。这些资产只有在通过回归检查并获得人工批准后才会更新。我们在三个已部署的、超过200步的工作流上对该方法进行了评估。在领域A上，一个包含120个案例的端到端评估集显示：无人值守完成率从50%提升至100%，检索召回率从56%提升至91.67%，端到端延迟从440分钟降至159分钟，且场景分析……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Co-Sight Harness框架，通过将工作流定义、状态与领域知识外部化为可版本化的控制资产，并借助状态机、机器可校验的验收门控和独立审计器进行确定性强制执行，在不改动底层语言模型的情况下，使超过200步的长程业务工作流无人值守完成率从50%提升至100%、端到端延迟降低约64%。
en_tdlr: Co-Sight Harness externalizes workflow definitions, state, and domain knowledge into versioned control assets enforced deterministically by a state machine, machine-checkable acceptance gates, and an independent auditor, raising unattended completion of 200+ step long-horizon business workflows from 50% to 100% while cutting end-to-end latency by about 64%, all without modifying the underlying language model.
